"info" : "warning"; return cloneElement(container, { children: {label} }); } export function desktopRow(index: number, columns: string[]) { const row = desktopRows[index] as ReactElement<{ children?: ReactNode; }>; const cells = Children.toArray(row.props.children).map((node, position) => { if (position !== 1) return node; const cell = node as WithChildren; return cloneElement(cell, { children: withLayoutBadge(Children.only(cell.props.children) as WithChildren) }); }).filter((_, position) => columns.includes(columnNames[position])); return cloneElement(row, { children: cells }); } export function mobileCard(index: number, columns: string[], reduceMotion = false) { const card = mobileCards[index] as ReactElement<{ children?: ReactNode; }>; const [identity, fields] = Children.toArray(card.props.children) as ReactElement<{ children?: ReactNode; }>[]; const visibleFields = Children.toArray(fields.props.children).map((node, position) => { if (position !== 0) return node; const field = node as WithChildren; const [heading, value] = Children.toArray(field.props.children); return cloneElement(field, { children: [heading, withLayoutBadge(value as WithChildren)] }); }).filter((_, position) => columns.includes(columnNames[position + 1])); return {identity}{cloneElement(fields, { children: visibleFields })}; }
